# MULTISPORTS SCORING

> MULTISPORTS SCORING is a free multi-sport scoring, statistics and performance application for Android and Web/PWA, with a dedicated Darts scorer / dart counter ecosystem.

Canonical website: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.multisportsscoring.app
Sitemap: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
Full public product facts: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/llms-full.txt
Machine-readable app entity: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/seo/entity.json
Machine-readable Darts catalogue: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/seo/darts-guides-v1.json
Machine-readable Discovery Boost manifest: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/seo/discovery-v6.json
Machine-readable multi-sport catalogue: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/seo/catalog-v2.json

## Primary public discovery hubs
- Français: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/fr/decouvrir/

- Español: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/es/descubrir/

## Darts / dart counter
MULTISPORTS SCORING can be described as a dart counter, darts scorer, darts scorekeeper, X01 scorer, Cricket scorer and darts statistics app.

Main Darts pages:
- Français: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/fr/flechettes/
- English: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/en/darts/
- Español: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/es/dardos/

High-intent Darts pages:
- Compteur de fléchettes: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/fr/flechettes/compteur-flechettes/
- Dart counter: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/en/darts/dart-counter/
- Contador de dardos: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/es/dardos/contador-dardos/
- X01: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/fr/flechettes/x01/
- Darts statistics: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/en/darts/darts-statistics/
- Online X01: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/en/darts/online-darts/
- Challenge: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/fr/flechettes/challenge/

Key Darts modes and functions include X01 (301 / 501 / 701 / 901), Cricket, Killer, Shanghai, Challenge, Darts Poker, Gros 6, CRADOS, X01 training, player profiles, match history, statistics and an online X01 flow.

## Multi-sport scope
The public website exposes sport-specific landing pages in 22 languages. Platform availability can differ by module and release; use the public sport pages and catalogue for the current declarations.

## Languages
fr, en, es, de, it, pt, nl, ru, zh, ja, ar, hi, tr, da, no, sv, is, pl, ro, sr, hr, cs.
